targets.rawSql: select count(*) as value from analytics.email_events where type = 'sent' and $__timeFilter(at)
select count(*) as value from analytics.email_events where type = 'delivered' and $__timeFilter(at)
select count(distinct email_id) as value from analytics.email_events where type = 'opened' and $__timeFilter(at)
select count(distinct email_id) as value from analytics.email_events where type = 'clicked' and $__timeFilter(at)
select count(*) as value from analytics.email_events where type = 'bounced' and $__timeFilter(at)
select count(*) as value from analytics.email_events where type = 'complained' and $__timeFilter(at)

panels.title: Open rate (unique opens / delivered)

targets.rawSql: select count(distinct email_id) filter (where type = 'opened')::float / nullif(count(*) filter (where type = 'delivered'), 0) as value from analytics.email_events where $__timeFilter(at)

panels.description: Apple Mail Privacy Protection and some security scanners open emails automatically, so opens overstate real reading.

targets.rawSql: select count(distinct email_id) filter (where type = 'clicked')::float / nullif(count(*) filter (where type = 'delivered'), 0) as value from analytics.email_events where $__timeFilter(at)

select count(distinct email_id) filter (where type = 'clicked')::float / nullif(count(distinct email_id) filter (where type = 'opened'), 0) as value from analytics.email_events where $__timeFilter(at)
select count(distinct user_id) as value from analytics.email_events where type = 'sent' and $__timeFilter(at)
select count(distinct user_id) as value from analytics.email_events where type = 'opened' and $__timeFilter(at)
select count(distinct user_id) as value from analytics.email_events where type = 'clicked' and $__timeFilter(at)

panels.title: Users who clicked, then were active within 24h

targets.rawSql:
with acts as (
  select user_id as u, created_at as t from analytics.intents
  union all select sender_id, created_at from analytics.messages
  union all select actor_user_id, at from analytics.opportunity_events where type = 'committed'
) select count(distinct e.user_id) as value from analytics.email_events e where e.type = 'clicked' and $__timeFilter(e.at) and exists (select 1 from acts a where a.u = e.user_id and a.t > e.at and a.t <= e.at + interval '24 hours')

panels.description: Activity is a new intent, a message or a commit after the click. It shows people came back, not that the email caused it.

panels.title: Emailed users who never opened (share)

targets.rawSql: select 1 - count(distinct user_id) filter (where type = 'opened')::float / nullif(count(distinct user_id) filter (where type = 'sent'), 0) as value from analytics.email_events where $__timeFilter(at)

panels.description: Of the users sent a tracked email in the range, the share with no open event in it. Open tracking misses people who block images.

panels.title: Users per day: emailed, opened, clicked

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(at,'1d'), count(distinct user_id) filter (where type = 'sent') as emailed, count(distinct user_id) filter (where type = 'opened') as opened, count(distinct user_id) filter (where type = 'clicked') as clicked from analytics.email_events where $__timeFilter(at) group by 1 order by 1

panels.title: Emailed users by number of opens in range

targets.rawSql:
select bucket, users from (
  with s as (select user_id, count(*) filter (where type = 'opened') as opens from analytics.email_events where user_id is not null and $__timeFilter(at) group by 1 having count(*) filter (where type = 'sent') > 0)
  select '1 none' as bucket, count(*) as users from s where opens = 0
  union all select '2 one', count(*) from s where opens = 1
  union all select '3 two to four', count(*) from s where opens between 2 and 4
  union all select '4 five or more', count(*) from s where opens >= 5
) b order by bucket

panels.title: Sent per day by email type

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(at,'1d'), coalesce(kind, 'untagged') as metric, count(*) as value from analytics.email_events where type = 'sent' and $__timeFilter(at) group by 1,2 order by 1

panels.title: Opens per day

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(at,'1d'), count(*) as opens, count(distinct email_id) as unique_opens from analytics.email_events where type = 'opened' and $__timeFilter(at) group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Opens counts every open event. Unique opens counts each email once per day.

panels.title: Clicks per day

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(at,'1d'), count(*) as clicks, count(distinct email_id) as unique_clicks from analytics.email_events where type = 'clicked' and $__timeFilter(at) group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Clicks counts every click event. Unique clicks counts each email once per day.

panels.title: Daily open and click rate

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(at,'1d'), count(distinct email_id) filter (where type = 'opened')::float / nullif(count(*) filter (where type = 'delivered'), 0) as open_rate, count(distinct email_id) filter (where type = 'clicked')::float / nullif(count(*) filter (where type = 'delivered'), 0) as click_rate from analytics.email_events where $__timeFilter(at) group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Counted on the day each event happened, not the day the email was sent, so a rate can pass 100% on a day with late opens.

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(at,'1d'), type as metric, count(*) as value from analytics.email_events where type in ('bounced', 'complained', 'failed', 'delivery_delayed') and $__timeFilter(at) group by 1,2 order by 1

select coalesce(kind, 'untagged') as email_type,
  count(*) filter (where type = 'sent') as sent,
  count(*) filter (where type = 'delivered') as delivered,
  count(distinct email_id) filter (where type = 'opened') as unique_opens,
  count(distinct email_id) filter (where type = 'clicked') as unique_clicks,
  count(distinct user_id) filter (where type = 'opened') as users_opened,
  count(distinct user_id) filter (where type = 'clicked') as users_clicked,
  count(distinct email_id) filter (where type = 'opened')::float / nullif(count(*) filter (where type = 'delivered'), 0) as open_rate,
  count(distinct email_id) filter (where type = 'clicked')::float / nullif(count(*) filter (where type = 'delivered'), 0) as click_rate,
  count(*) filter (where type = 'bounced') as bounced,
  count(*) filter (where type = 'complained') as complained
from analytics.email_events where $__timeFilter(at) group by 1 order by sent desc
